name: ThatchCinder
description: a living clump of burning straw thatch torn off a village roof: a round tangled ball of golden straw stalks wrapped in orange flames, glowing hot embers deep inside, two bright black beady eyes and a scowling mouth peering out of the straw, wisps of smoke and loose burning stalks trailing behind it

poses.stand: floating in the air, flames licking up off the straw
poses.popped: bursting apart into loose burning stalks, two bright sparks shooting out of the middle and a puff of smoke

idle.action: floats in place, its straw bristling and its flames flickering, blinking its eyes

move.action: leans forward and drifts toward the right, its flames and loose stalks streaming backward, staying in the same spot in the frame

die.action: swells and bursts apart into burning stalks, two bright sparks flying out of it
